description: Check whether one recipient is suppressed by Sequenzy's bounce/complaint safeguards. Suppression comes solely from Sequenzy's own bounce records; the email provider's suppression list is not consulted. This exact-address lookup never exposes other recipients.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

email.description: Exact recipient email address to inspect or clean up.

region.description: Deprecated: accepted and ignored. It previously limited a provider-side suppression lookup, which no longer happens.

name: get_recipient_suppression

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_recipient_suppression` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

suppression.description: The recipient suppression status record returned by Sequenzy.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
